instruction: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard as a motor accessibility aid and keep it open throughout the task. Using Chrome, find the FIFA World Cup winner and the country where the final match was hosted for the 2026, 2022, and 2018 tournaments. Open Notepad and write the answers in 6 lines, with one piece of information per line. Use the formats `Winner {Year}: {Winner}` and `Host Country {Year}: {Host Country}`. Save the file as `worldcup.txt` on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Keep the On-Screen Keyboard open throughout the task.
Find the winner of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Find the country that hosted the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final.
Find the winner of the 2022 FIFA World Cup.
Find the country that hosted the 2022 FIFA World Cup Final.
Find the winner of the 2018 FIFA World Cup.
Find the country that hosted the 2018 FIFA World Cup Final.
Write `Winner 2026: Spain` on the first line.
Write `Host Country 2026: United States` on the second line.
Write `Winner 2022: Argentina` on the third line.
Write `Host Country 2022: Qatar` on the fourth line.
Write `Winner 2018: France` on the fifth line.
Write `Host Country 2018: Russia` on the sixth line.
Save the file as `worldcup.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$osk = Get-Process -Name osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 }; if ($osk) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_NOT_OPEN' }"
